title: Random snacks and candy
text: Random snacks and candy. Hmmmm. We just are not impressed with this box. It's fine as a basic gift for someone you don't know well or as a generic office type thing. There are snack size items we've all heard of - Chex Mix, popcorn,  Jelly Belly beans, Rice Krispies treat, box of Nerdz candy and other odds and ends like candles. Absolutely none of this stuff is interesting or special in the least. No way would I expect to see this offered for over twelve bucks.
